children: EVI Industries amended two agreements tied to its Sudsies acquisitions, converting remaining stock components to all cash. On Aug 31, 2026, the company shifted the Sudsies On-Site asset purchase to $900,000 all cash and the personal goodwill purchase from Jason Loeb to $7,124,778 all cash. The company announced the deals closed on Sep 1, 2026, and subsequently paid about $1.9 million to vehicle lessors and reimbursed $860,000 in employee bonuses. The changes are intended to streamline execution and simplify consideration at closing.
